changelog: Added BrowserScreen to handle web content within the app.
Introduced BrowserUrlPolicy for URL validation and normalization.
Updated MainViewModel to manage browser requests and navigation.
Integrated in-app browser settings in the SettingsScreen.
Added functionality to open links in the in-app browser or external browser based on user preference.
Enhanced AboutPterodroidDialog and AccountSettingsSheet to utilize the new browser functionality.
Implemented unit tests for BrowserUrlPolicy to ensure URL handling correctness.
